questions.mappingNote: All eighteen parts assess sketching the reciprocal from a supplied graph. questions.methodNote: The solutions apply the supplied graphical method: retain each abscissa, reciprocate nonzero ordinates, exclude zeros, preserve signs, use signed approaches to zero for vertical-asymptote behaviour, reciprocate end limits, and reverse monotonicity separately on sign-consistent intervals. Nonzero extrema retain their abscissae and reverse type; zero-height extrema have no reciprocal image. Parts o and p correctly use the graph's unlabelled zero positions without demanding exact surd coordinates. Parts q and r likewise retain graphical extrema without introducing an equation-finding requirement. The worked answers use signed approaches explicitly, so the separately recorded qualification issue in teaching block p5-rule-1-asymptote does not invalidate these solutions.
